name: Signage
note: Installed price incl. fabrication, foundation, installation and electrical hookup; excludes sign permits/variances (soft cost) unless noted. Evidence is vendor/marketing guides only (low confidence); web search budget ran out before municipal or consultant sources could be found.

items.name: Monument sign (ground-mounted, masonry/aluminum base, illuminated)

cost.method: AlphaGraphics guide (e1, 2026): basic $5,000–$15,000, mid-range (premium materials, LED/halo lighting) $15,000–$40,000, premium $40,000–$100,000+. Mid = midpoint of the mid-range tier (typical project entry sign); low = basic tier mid; high = lower half of premium tier. Excludes LED message centers ($15k–$300k+ per e1).

items.notes: One per primary entrance is typical. Landscaping around the sign is carried in landscaping.

items.name: Pylon sign (multi-tenant, 20–40 ft, illuminated)

cost.method: BlinkSigns (e2, 2023) puts 'pylon business signs' at $5,000–$15,000, which reflects small single-tenant pole signs. Multi-tenant shopping-center/highway pylons need engineered drilled-pier foundations, steel structure and multiple illuminated cabinets; by analogy with e1's monument tiers (foundation $1.5k–$15k, fabrication up to $80k+, installation with crane $2k–$15k+), a 20–40 ft multi-tenant pylon is set at $25k (low) / $75k (mid) / $200k (high, tall highway pylon with LED message center). Judgment — verify with a sign fabricator quote.

items.notes: Often restricted or prohibited by local sign codes; check zoning first.

items.name: Building-mounted sign (illuminated channel letters / blade sign)

cost.method: BlinkSigns channel-letter guide (e3, 2026): most single-storefront illuminated channel letter projects $4,000–$12,000; FAQ range $3,000–$20,000+. Low = e3 low; mid ≈ upper-middle of the planning range for a project ID sign larger than a storefront; high = e3 FAQ high + premium (halo-lit, large-format building ID).

items.notes: Per sign face. Retail: one per tenant (often tenant-paid). Multifamily/hotel: 1–3 building ID signs.

items.name: Wayfinding & code signage package (directional, ADA room ID, building/unit numbering)

cost.method: No source captured (web search limit reached). Judgment: low = small commercial building (ADA room ID, exit/code signs, a few directional signs); mid = 200–300-unit garden multifamily or mid-size hotel (unit numbers, building numbers, vehicular directionals, amenity and code signage ≈ $150–$250 per dwelling unit); high = campus-scale/multi-building project with illuminated vehicular wayfinding. Verify against an interior signage sub's quote.

items.notes: Scale with project size — roughly $0.50–$1.50 per GSF for interior code/ID signage on commercial buildings (judgment).

source.title: Monument Signs for Businesses: A Complete Guide

evidence.scopeNotes: Vendor guide (July 2026). Tiers: basic $5k–$15k; mid-range $15k–$40k (premium materials, LED/halo lighting); premium $40k–$100k+. LED illumination adds $5k–$30k+.

source.title: Signage Cost for Business: How Much Should You Expect to Pay?

evidence.quote: On average, pylon business signs cost anywhere between $5,000 and $15,000.
evidence.scopeNotes: Vendor blog (Sept 2023); reflects small single-tenant pylons. Same page: general business sign average 'between $2,000 to $3,000'.
